t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes are always paired the same. They are never altered. Should use the lower risk games (x1 scores) to 'test' out which gnome would score the most, and the higher value games(x5) to try and harvest the more mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: Each round has two gnomes, and the pairings stay the same throughout the game. For example, a gnome wearing a pink hat will always be paired with a gnome wearing a blue hat. The gnome wearing the purple hat will always be paired with one wearing a red hat. My advice is to use the lower risk games, that score x1 to 'test' which gnome would score the most. Then when it is x5, follow the previous results. At some point throughout the game, is gnome that pays out more may switch. Once again, use the x1 games to test it out so you don't end up missing more on the higher paying rounds
